text:
liz (design): quick sync 2023 Compliance panel2 mock feedback: a few copy + a11y nits around the Retention + Region selector and the KMS badges. dropping screenshots in the thread in a sec.

jon (eng): saw the screenshots. main concern: how much detail do we show inline for KMS keys? we can't show full key material obviously, but key IDs can be long.

tara (security): agree with truncation. security policy requires a non-guessable reference for auditability (e.g., key reference or alias). we should display provider + alias, with the token truncated and tooltip for full ref.

liz (design): proposed badge text options:
- "Customer-managed (KMS)"
- "Managed by Redwood"
Which variant reads better on the small badge? also debating Title Case vs sentence case.

paul (prod): prefer "Customer-managed (KMS)" and "Redwood-managed". short, explicit. keep Title Case for badges so they look like labels across console.

jon (eng): implementation note: badges need an accessible label that screen readers can read: something like `aria-label="Encryption: Customer-managed KMS, provider AWS KMS, key alias alpha-1234 (truncated)"`. liz, can we make the visible text shorter?

liz (design): yes — visible: "Customer-managed (KMS)" and below small text: "AWS KMS 1234" (last 4 chars). full string in tooltip. also we'll add `aria-describedby` pointing at the help text block.

paul (prod): help text for the retention dropdown draft: "Retention controls how long Redwood stores request and response data for diagnostics and billing. Choose a region to retain data in that jurisdiction." Add: "If we cannot serve your selected region, we'll route to the nearest eligible region and log the event."

tara (security): wording tweak: please replace "route to the nearest eligible region" with "temporarily serve from a fallback region" 1 to avoid implying permanent moves. Also ensure audit log includes both `intended_region` and `served_region`.

jon (eng): good call. audit log example I'm proposing: ```[2026-06-05T09:12:01Z] paul@acme changed retention 7d -> 90d; intended_region=eu-west-1; served_region=us-east-1; encryption="Customer-managed (AWS KMS, alias=acme-prod)"```

liz (design): looks fine. small UX request: shorted alias with ellipsis in UI (e.g., `alias=acme-prod8...9`) and make the whole quoted encryption part a link to the Key details modal.

audit-bot: REMINDER: Logs must not include secret material. Do not render key material or full ARNs in user-facing logs.

paul (prod): also let's standardize capitalization: use "Customer-managed KMS" in badges and "Customer-managed (KMS)" in logs to make the console + exported CSV consistent.

jon (eng): minor: CSV export is currently column-named `encryption_type`. We should move to `encryption` with quoted token so it reads as the UI: `Customer-managed (AWS KMS, alias=acme-prod...)`.

liz (design): a11y checklist:
- region dropdown has `aria-describedby` referencing help text
- badges are keyboard-focusable and have visible focus ring (contrast >= 3:1)
- truncated key aliases provide aria-label with full text
- toast announcements for fallback must use polite live region

tara (security): add: the toast when fallback happens must include a link to the audit entry or an instruction: "See Audit Log for full details." and only show :warning: emoji if the fallback crosses a compliance boundary (e.g., EU -> non-EU).

paul (prod): toast copy suggestion: `Serving from us-east-1 (fallback). See Audit Log for details.` short and consistent. append `:warning:` only when policy requires.

jon (eng): I'll implement:
- badge text + tooltip pattern
- truncated alias with `...` and modal link
- audit log structured single-line format (ISO8601 time, user, action, intended/served region, encryption token in quotes)
- feature-flagged toast text for A/B testing wording

liz (design): timeline: I'll upload updated PNGs & a11y notes by tomorrow noon. please review copy + modal link pattern after that.

paul (prod): thanks all. tagged follow-ups: @tara verify log schema change, @jon add CSV header change to the migration PR, @liz drop final assets. :thumbsup:

jon (eng): noted. will ping when PR is up.

liz (design): dropping the screenshots now -> https://files.redwood/designs/compliance-retention-v4.png

paul (prod): awesome. closing loop here once PR hits staging.

jon (eng): closing with one more example of audit line for copy: ```[2026-06-05T09:12:01Z] paul@acme updated retention: 7d -> 90d; intended_region=eu-west-1; served_region=eu-west-1; encryption="Customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, alias=acme-prod...)"```

liz (design): thanks everyone :sparkles:
